verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is indirect: the default firewall leaves port 53317 open for LocalSend, which implies a bundled LocalSend for moving files between machines over the network. Nothing documents migrating settings or running a guided transfer from an old computer. The Windows VM shared folder only moves files between the VM and the host, not from another machine. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a file-transfer workflow from an old machine, any settings/profile migration tool, and hands-on corroboration of the switching experience.
